text:
Asha: Throwing out a silly idea  "Alchemy Mocktail Lab" + potion-themed boardgames next Wed evening? 6:30 start, tiny DIY mocktail station + table for 4-6 players. :test_tube: :game_die:
Ben: absolutely. can we keep it non-alcoholic? i'm driving and prefer sober nights.
Carmen: love the theme. can someone make a tiny recipe card for the mocktails? i can print a few.
Diego: i'll bring the mixers (ginger, lime, hibiscus syrup) and a battery-operated jigger. also a Bluetooth speaker.
Lena: any allergies to note? i'm allergic to peanuts and prefer coconut-free mixes.
Asha: noted re: peanuts & coconut. we'll label everything. thinking budget $10 suggested for contributions to supplies. okay? :money_with_wings:
Ben: $10 fine. i can bring sparkling water and ice.
Carmen: i'll do recipe cards and bring glassware (plastic backup if needed). maybe a small prize for best-named potion? :trophy:
Diego: speaking of names, we should have 3 "base potions" (calm, spark, zing) and mixers to customize. anyone wants to prototype recipes?
Lena: i can prototype a vegan shrub base (apple + vinegar + rosemary). no dairy.
Asha: perfect. EventBot can you spin up a quick RSVP + "perform a short table intro" poll? also cap at 12 people, space is small.
EventBot: Poll created: "Alchemy Mocktail Lab RSVP & host a table intro" Options: Yes - host intro, Yes - just attend, Maybe, No. Link: https://events.example/poll/alchemy2069
Ben: RSVP yes - can host a table intro with a one-minute fake backstory for the potion names.
Carmen: RSVP yes - bringing printed recipe cards.
Diego: RSVP yes - bringing mixers. also open to driving folks from Mission area.
Lena: RSVP yes. bringing vegan dippers (fruit + rice crackers).
Asha: Games list idea: Potion Explosion (fits theme), Mystery Express (short), and a few quick filler games (Sushi Go, Love Letter). any other recs?
Ben: Potion Explosion is perfect. i have it and can bring. also a small foam mat for spill protection.
Carmen: Mystery Express is great. i'll bring Sushi Go as a warmup.
Diego: logistics: meet in lobby 6:20 to grab the elevator? We'll need a passing tray for mocktails to avoid spills in hallways.
Lena: can we ask security about rooftop access after hours? if rooftop blocked, fallback to lounge.
Asha: good call. EventBot: reminder to check rooftop availability and set a 24-hr heads-up.
EventBot: Reminder set and message sent to facilities to confirm rooftop availability.
Ben: costume optional? simple props like wizard hats would be fun but not required.
Carmen: i'll bring a couple of cheap hats + name tags for potions.
Diego: rides: i'm driving 3 seats, leaving 6:00 from Valencia & 18th. DM if you need a lift.
Lena: i'm taking BART, but thanks.
Asha: final practicals: sticker labels for allergens, napkins, and a small tip jar for supplies if people want to chip in more than $10. i'll create the calendar invite and add the link to the RSVP poll.
Carmen: thanks! also can someone add a note: 'no open flames' near mocktail station.
Asha: done. calendar invite: https://calendar.example/event/alchemy-mocktail-lab
Diego: can someone bring paper towels? i'm clumsy.
Ben: broughtcha. see you Wed  bring your best potion name and game face. :sparkles:
